title: Orca brings multiple coding agents, worktrees and review into one environment
friendlyTitle: Orca puts several coding agents in one workspace
summary: Orca is an open-source agent development environment for running coding-agent CLIs in parallel, with each task isolated in a Git worktree. It combines terminals, diffs, browser tools, remote machines and mobile monitoring while allowing users to bring existing agent subscriptions.
friendlySummary: Orca lets developers run different coding agents side by side. Each agent can work in its own Git worktree, with tools for review and remote access.
whyItMatters: The interface around coding agents is evolving from a single chat window into an operations console. Isolation and review are the important features: they let teams increase parallel work without letting agents overwrite one another or quietly merge unchecked changes.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Separate workspaces reduce conflicts. A clear review screen also helps a person check the agents’ changes before accepting them.
